room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing below the village.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass. Lamps hang from its lowest branches, and a squat belfry stands to the east.
room.belfry.title: Belfry
room.belfry.description: A bell the size of a cart hangs from a beam, its rope wound around a cleat.
npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands. He keeps the landing by day and goes up to the green at dusk.
npc.maud.room: [Maud] is here, listening to everyone at once.
npc.maud.description: Maud knows everything said on the green by evening, and goes down to the landing to say it again.
